etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 气 'breath' (phonetic キ) — water become breath: steam.
mnemonic: Water exhaling — キ. 汽車: the train that ran on sighs.

etymology: Pictograph: an unstrung bow in profile.
mnemonic: The curve waiting for its string — ゆみ. It arms 引, 強, 弱 across the dictionary.

etymology: Pictograph: a single-edged blade with its curved back. As a right-side component it sharpens into 刂.
mnemonic: The katana's silhouette in two strokes — かたな. 日本刀: the pictograph, forged.

etymology: Pictograph: an arrow — head at the top, fletching below.
mnemonic: Nocked and ready — や. Inside 知 it's the answer in flight.

etymology: Compound ideograph: fields (田) on tilled earth (土) — a settlement and the old league measuring the walk between them.
mnemonic: Field plus soil equals home village — さと. ふるさと的距離: measured in 里.

etymology: Compound ideograph: many rooms (呂) under one great roof (宀) — a palace; the god's palace: a shrine.
mnemonic: Room after room under the sacred roof — みや. 宮崎, 神宮: palaces on the map.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 寺 (phonetic シ) — words measured like temple bells: poetry.
mnemonic: Language that keeps temple time — シ. 詩人: the bell-keeper.

etymology: Phono-semantic: sun (日) + 召 (phonetic ショウ) — light called forth: shining, luminous.
mnemonic: The kanji of the 昭和 era — ショウ: the sun summoned onto a whole century.

etymology: Pictograph: a nail seen from the side — borrowed for city blocks (丁目) and for the politeness of 丁寧.
mnemonic: One nail pins one block of the city grid — チョウ. 丁寧: work done to the last nail.

etymology: Phono-semantic: cloth (巾) + 長 (phonetic チョウ) — the long hanging register: account book, notebook.
mnemonic: The ledger unrolling like drapery — チョウ. 手帳: the pocket edition.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 由 (phonetic テキ) — the bored bamboo pipe: a flute, a whistle.
mnemonic: Bamboo with a reason (由) to sing — ふえ. 口笛: the built-in model.

etymology: Pictograph: a stemmed offering vessel — borrowed long ago for the beans it held.
mnemonic: The dish that became its contents — まめ. 豆腐: beans, transfigured.

etymology: Pictograph: a sheep's head with curling horns — the favored offering, hiding inside 美, 洋, 善.
mnemonic: Horns, ears, muzzle — ひつじ. The quietest component in the beautiful kanji.

etymology: Pictograph: the wooden frame around a well mouth.
mnemonic: Four beams crossed over the water — い. 天井: the ceiling, the room's well-frame overhead.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 中 (phonetic チュウ) — out in the middle water: the offing.
mnemonic: Where the land stops mattering — おき. 沖縄: the islands out in the middle.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 牙 'tusk' (phonetic ガ) — the shoot breaking soil like a tusk: a bud.
mnemonic: Spring's first fang — め. 芽が出る: talent and tulips, same verb.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 加 (phonetic ガ) + 貝 — gifts added to good news: felicitation.
mnemonic: Joy plus an envelope of cash — ガ. 年賀状: congratulations, postmarked January 1st.

etymology: Phono-semantic: crossroads (行) + 圭 (phonetic ガイ) — the built-up streets between: boulevard, quarter.
mnemonic: The road with shops sewn to both edges — まち. 商店街: the arcade of it.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 舄 (phonetic セキ) — shallow tidal flats: a lagoon.
mnemonic: Water that can't decide if it's land — かた. 新潟: the new lagoon, now a prefecture.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mountain (山) + 支 'branch' (phonetic キ) — where the mountain path splits: a fork.
mnemonic: The trail forks at the ridge — キ. 岐阜: the prefecture at the fork; 分岐点: life's version.

etymology: Phono-semantic: the streaming-banner radical + 其 (phonetic キ) — the standard raised: a flag.
mnemonic: The pole, the wind, the claim — はた. 国旗: identity on fabric.

etymology: Simplified from 擧: many hands lifting together — to raise up, cite, hold (an event).
mnemonic: Hands up, all at once — あげる. 選挙: raising hands nationally.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 竟 (phonetic キョウ) — polished bronze that gives back the face: a mirror.
mnemonic: Metal that learned your face — かがみ. 眼鏡: mirrors for the eyes, めがね.

etymology: Compound: 能 (originally the bear pictograph) with fire-dots restored as paws — the bear itself.
mnemonic: 能 went into grammar, so the animal grew paws — くま. 熊本: bear country, officially.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 君 (phonetic グン) + city (阝) — the lord's administrative district: a county.
mnemonic: The lord's slice of the map — グン. Rural addresses still carry it.

etymology: Phono-semantic: path (彳) + 巠 (phonetic ケイ) — the direct footpath; geometry's shortest crossing: diameter.
mnemonic: The shortcut straight through the circle — ケイ. 直径: the honest path.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 工 (phonetic コウ) + strength (力) — work backed by muscle: merit, service.
mnemonic: Craft times effort equals credit — コウ. 成功: the receipt for both.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 左 (phonetic サ) — the person at your left hand: an aide.
mnemonic: The left-hand man — サ. 佐藤: Japan's most common surname carries him.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mountain (山) + 奇 (phonetic キ) — the mountain jutting oddly into the sea: a cape.
mnemonic: The cliff that wouldn't stop at the shore — さき. 長崎, 宮崎: capes turned cities.

etymology: Pictograph read as a root or a ladle — the family stem: clan, surname; the neutral honorific 〜氏.
mnemonic: The root every family tree stands on — シ. 田中氏: Mr. Tanaka, rootstock included.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 茲 (phonetic ジ) — waters that make things thrive: nourishing.
mnemonic: The water plants would order by name — ジ. 滋養: nutrition, poetically.

etymology: Pictograph: a deer — antlers, body and legs still visible in the strokes.
mnemonic: Antlers under a cliff-shaped sky — しか. 鹿児島: deer island; Nara: their kingdom.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 昌 (phonetic ショウ) — the voice raised bright: to chant, advocate.
mnemonic: One mouth, two suns of volume — となえる. 合唱: many mouths, one chant.

etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 公 (phonetic ショウ) — the evergreen lord of trees: the pine.
mnemonic: The public tree at every gate and New Year — まつ. 松島: pines with a sea view.

etymology: Pictograph: a granary — roof, door, and store-room stacked.
mnemonic: The rice bank — くら. 鎌倉: the warehouse that ran a shogunate.

etymology: Pictograph: birds' nests in the treetop — a nest, a den, a hideout.
mnemonic: Twigs piled on the tree's crown — す. 巣立ち: leaving it, the graduation metaphor.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + a phonetic — troops filing along the ridge: a unit, a corps.
mnemonic: A column snaking down the hill — タイ. 自衛隊, 探検隊: squads of every stripe.

etymology: Pictograph: the sacred text laid on its stand — the canon: code, precedent, ceremony.
mnemonic: The big book on the lectern — テン. 辞典, 古典: the books that outrank books.

etymology: Compound: walking (彳) with a straight-seen heart (直+心) — conduct upright at every step: virtue.
mnemonic: Ten eyes watch the heart walk: it stays straight anyway — トク. 徳島: virtue with a bridge.

etymology: Phono-semantic character borrowed almost purely for sound — most famous as the 奈 of 奈良 and 神奈川.
mnemonic: The big altar syllable — ナ. 奈良: where the deer keep the altar.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 繩): thread (糸) + a phonetic — twisted straw cordage: rope.
mnemonic: The sacred rope on shrine trees — なわ. 沖縄: the rope of islands.

etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 毎 (phonetic バイ) — the tree that blooms first every year: the plum.
mnemonic: Every (毎) spring's opening act — うめ. 梅雨: the plum rains of June.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 十 'complete' + 尃 (phonetic ハク) — learning spread wide: extensive; the extensively learned: doctor.
mnemonic: Ten specialties and one extra dot of genius — ハク. 博物館: the doctor's attic, public.

etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + 爰 (phonetic エン) — a graceful lady: princess.
mnemonic: The lady the rope of helpers surrounds — ひめ. 愛媛: the beloved princess prefecture.

etymology: Originally sparks flying up — light slips of paper drifting: tickets, ballots.
mnemonic: Paper slips rising like sparks from the ballot box — ヒョウ. 投票: casting your spark.

etymology: Compound ideograph: cattle (牛) driven with the stick (攵) — herding: to pasture, raise.
mnemonic: The herder's tap on the flank — まき. 牧場: the office of cows.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 羊 (phonetic ヨウ) + food (食) — feeding the flock: to nourish, rear.
mnemonic: Feed the lamb until it's family — やしなう. 栄養: nourishment, itemized.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 利 (phonetic リ) + tree (木) — the orchard's crisp profit: the pear.
mnemonic: The tree whose fruit pays (利) — なし. 山梨: pear-mountain, grape country ironically.
